fields.description: Master on/off switch for MijnRood sync polling
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Alternative to stored key: absolute path to SSH private key file on the server (file must have 0600 permissions)
fields.label: SSH Private Key Path

fields.description: Use the 'Set SSH Key' and 'Set SSH Passphrase' buttons in the toolbar to update credentials. Values are stored encrypted.
fields.label: SSH Credentials

fields.description: Paste the SSH private key content directly. Stored encrypted. Use the 'Set SSH Key' button for multi-line paste. Takes priority over Key Path. Hidden in the form to prevent browser password-manager prompts.
fields.label: SSH Private Key

fields.description: SSH login password (only when using password auth, not key auth). Hidden in the form to prevent browser password-manager prompts.
fields.label: SSH Password

fields.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key, if it is encrypted. Leave empty for unencrypted keys. Hidden in the form to prevent browser password-manager prompts.
fields.label: SSH Key Passphrase

fields.description: Enable only if the SSH server runs OpenSSH < 7.2 (e.g. CentOS 5/6 with OpenSSH 5.3). Forces paramiko to use plain ssh-rsa (SHA-1) signatures for RSA pubkey auth instead of the modern rsa-sha2-256/512 algorithms, which the old server cannot understand. Leave off for modern hosts — SHA-1 is weaker.
fields.label: Legacy SSH Compatibility (OpenSSH < 7.2)

fields.description: MariaDB host as seen from the SSH server
fields.label: Database Host

fields.description: How often to poll MijnRood for changes (in minutes)
fields.label: Poll Interval (minutes)

fields.description: JSON list of MijnRood database tables to poll
fields.label: Tables to Sync

fields.description: Not yet implemented. Planned: automatically apply non-destructive changes (address, phone, email updates) without manual review.
fields.label: Auto-apply Safe Changes

fields.description: Queue Account Creation Requests for all synced members who don't have a user account yet. Uses the standard ACR pipeline with deduplication.
fields.label: Maak Gebruikersaccounts Aan

fields.description: Maps MijnRood membership status IDs to Verenigingen membership types. Use 'Fetch from MijnRood' to populate from the live database.
fields.label: MijnRood Lidmaatschapstypes

fields.description: Maps MijnRood admin roles (ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_DIVISION_CONTACT) to actions in Verenigingen. Configure whether to create Volunteer records, assign Frappe roles, or add members to Chapter boards.
fields.label: MijnRood Rollen

fields.description: One-time import of documents from MijnRood's document organizer. Map each root folder to an organization and document type, then import.
fields.label: Document Import

fields.description: Absolute path on the remote SSH server where MijnRood stores uploaded files (the var/documents/ directory)
fields.label: Documents Remote Path
